title: PH60103: Quantum Many Body Theory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Examples of many body systems, second quantization, electron-phonon
interaction, spin systems, photons. Green s function at zero temperature: Smatrix, Wick s theorem, Feynman diagram, Dyson s eqn., phonon and photon Green
s function. Green s function at finite temperature: Imaginary time Green s
function, Matsubara formalism, frequency summation, linked cluster expansion,
analytic continuation. Applications: electrons in the presence of impurities ,
linear response, Kubo formulae, correlation functions. Electron gas, KE, direct
Coulomb , exchange, screening, Thomas-Fermi theory, RPA. Exactly solvable
models, T-matrix, Friedel sum rule, phase shift. Electron-phonon interaction,
superconductivity, liquid Helium.
